## Permissions

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-permissions
%%| fig-cap: "Questions about data reuse and data deletion."

flowchart TD
  subgraph S1["Notice about reuse of data"]
  A["Do you want to be notified when your data are reused?"] --- B["No"]
  A --- C["Yes"]
  C --- D["I want to be notified *before* my data are reused."]
  C --- F["I want to be notified when data are presented or published."]
  D --- G["I want notice only, but I do not want to approve specific reuse of my data."]
  D --- H["I want to approve each proposed use of my data on a case by case basis."]
  end
  subgraph S2["Right to data deletion"]
  M["What are your preferences about long-term storage of your data?"] --- N["I *waive* my right to request that my data be removed."]
  N --- O["I acknowledge where data will be stored, by whom, and for how long."]
  M --- P["I want to retain the right for my data to be removed."]
  P --- Q["I agree to keep contact information accurate and up-to-date."]
  end
  C --- Q
  
  style S1 fill:#fff, stroke:#333, stroke-width:4px, color:#222
  style S2 fill:#fff, stroke:#333, stroke-width:4px, color:#222
  style A color:#222
  style B color:#222
  style C color:#222
  style D color:#222
  style F color:#222
  style G color:#222
  style H color:#222
  style M color:#222
  style N color:#222
  style O color:#222
  style P color:#222
  style Q color:#222
```
